_comment: Single source of truth for paths deliberately NOT localized (KZ-210). Consumed by the i18n CI guards (KZ-602) and any rg/pseudo-locale wrapper — do not hardcode these globs anywhere else. Everything here stays ru-only: no t()/<Trans>, Cyrillic string literals are expected.
